text: Pon.Bike, the bicycle division of the Dutch Pon group, added Italian cycling-shoe brand Nimbl to its portfolio in 2023.

source.name: Bicycle Retailer & Industry News: Pon.Bike adds Nimbl shoe brand to portfolio
source.quote: Pon.Bike has added Italian road and track shoe brand Nimbl to its growing portfolio. Terms of the sale were not disclosed.
source.note: The same article says Nimbl's products are handmade in Porto Sant'Elpidio, Italy. Pon lists Nimbl among its companies at https://www.pon.com/en/companies/nimbl.
